reviews.author: Devin Brown
reviews.text: Been Looking For Another Professional Shop For My Personal & Business Vehicles , Great Customer Service And Care For Any Vehicle You Have Moore’s Definitely Took Care Of Everything I Needed From Engine Repair On My Old Van , From Oil Leaks On My Silverado , Even Takes Care Of My Benz , They Are By Far The Best Experience In A Local Shop I’ve Ever Had. Highly Recommended Them To All The Local Big Businesses In Petersburg. You Won’t Be Sorry You Came !!!!

reviews.author: Daniel Davis
reviews.text: I Called mores to have some body work done on my vette. They quoted me $1200 and said it would take 4 days to have it done but they needed to schedule me in about 3 weeks out. 3 weeks later I drop my car off and lonnnngggg story short it took them over 10 weeks and jumped my $1200 ticked to $1800. after repeatedly telling me the car would be done in a couple days only when I called them or stopped in to check on the status . I love to support local businesses and I don’t mind paying. I also even understand the price going up..that’s why it’s called an estimate. I just do not like being lied to and put on the back burner. I picked my car up today and my floor board in the driver side is soaking wet, a reflecter on the inside of my driver side door is cracked and I’m missing the volume knob on my radio! Terrible business! Also the window has grease all over it… what the heck?

reviews.author: Nevada Steele
reviews.text: I got new tires installed to include balancing. I purchased the tires from another place. I happened upon this business due to my impatience of not wanting to wait in line in other area shops. The entire staff was welcoming and professional. In conversation, I understood why they went into business. There is a passion for cars. My service was swift. I would recommend this business. No complaints.

reviews.author: Stacey Bassett
reviews.text: As we were driving south on vacation my husband realized that my VA state inspection had expired the previous month, oops! I quickly searched Google. We called and drove to several different shops but could not get anyone to help us. That was until I called Moore's Auto and Tow. Ashley was wonderful!!! She was able to squeeze us in. She had us back on the road very quickly. In talking with her we figured out that she/they are good at finding hard to find parts for classic cars. We will be calling them whenever we need parts for our classic truck. Even though we live on the opposite side of Virginia from them. I highly recommend Moore's Auto and Tow!

reviews.author: Jaa Bandy
reviews.text: What's not to love! Friendly, fast no hassle service. Fair prices. The only draw back from me is a 3% charge for using your credit card. Certainly doesn't take away from the 5 star service, cause they are fantastic, just sucks to add on a few more dollars to a bill for using a convenient way to pay.

reviews.author: James Edwards (Jim)
reviews.text: Fantastic staff to include front office, manager and technicians. Had a breakdown about 30 miles south of the shop. Called Moore's for an estimate on repairs. Prices were fair and they said they would keep someone there late that afternoon to get me back on the road same day if need be. Over the top commitment to customers. When the tow service failed to show up, called the shop and the front office said they are partnered with a towing company that could be there in 20 minutes. Problem solved. When the tow got my truck there, the manager showed me around the shop and got me in immediately. Repairs were complete in 45 minutes and I was on my merry way with a fair bill - to include parts and towing. Strongly recommend those local to Richmond check out Moore's. Good to see shops like this continue to be successful.

reviews.author: Kitty Boyd
reviews.text: I took my vehicle in for an AC check and found out the the entire system was bad. I knew the total amount that it would cost(labor and parts). I was informed that my vehicle would possibly take all day before I approved the work. I had my vehicle back in the time I was told and am very pleased. I highly recommend Moore's Auto and Towing. You feel like family.

reviews.author: King C
reviews.text: Eddie, Mrs. Ashley and the guys there take care of all my 3 of my vehicles. We are military and I recommend this shop for all service persons looking for a trustworthy repair and performance shop. It’s been 4 years of excellent service from them!

reviews.author: Chad Anthony
reviews.text: After several amazing experiences with Eddie and his crew, which are amazing From the front counter to the techs. Had to leave review they are Extremely knowledgeable,polite and genuinely care about their customers cars. Highly recommended this shop to anyone in need of repairs. They do custom work as well. From rebuilding your engine to lowering your ride or lifting it up. There is alot of knowledge in this shop and they take alot of pride in their work, you can trust your vehicle won't be short changed when in their hands. Hard to find shops these days knowing it will come out in better condition then it went in with moores auto you know your in good hands

reviews.author: Rene Hill
reviews.text: Amazing staff. They treat you like family. Eddie is always honest about your car repair. His wife is truly the sweetest person ever. This entire family is amazing. I refer anyone I know that needs honest car repair.

reviews.author: Tiffany Clary
reviews.text: Please do not fall victim to the unprofessionalism of this local business. My dad went to Moores to have a front end aligment done on his work van. The lady in the front office charged him twice for the part, so he had to get that straight. The front end was not aligned properly so he ended up having to take it back 5 TIMES and its still not aligned properly! His tire is folded inward and is very unsafe to drive. At this point we have asked for a full refund, however they only refunded the money for the part and nothing for the labor that They COULD NOT GET RIGHT out of all 5 times that it went into their shop. Everytime we call down there we get the run around and are lied too. Their only explaination is that they feel my dad has the van overloaded. This is an old comcast van that had hundreds of pounds more in the load than my dad has and there HAS NEVER BEEN AN ISSUE UNTIL MOORES WORKED ON IT. Now instead of morally doing the right thing to refund my dad the 300 dollars he spent , Moores could end up paying all the attorney fees and the expert witness that has weighed the van that my dad has loaded compared to the weight that comcast used, when all they had to do was the right thing and refund his money so he could take the van and have it fixed elsewhere. To the nasty lady in the office, nothing good comes to crooks and liars like you. Its a shame that your husbands business reputation has to be put on the line because of how nasty you are to people. Y'all may be used to mistreating your customers, but my dad is one that you will not get away with doing dirty! Signed a very angry daughter!

reviews.author: Kim Dixon
reviews.text: Hello Moore's family ! First and most , I want to thank the Moore's team so much for doing a wonderful job repair on Hyundai Santa Fe , 2010 , but most of all now I have find the family to keep my Lincoln Continental, Mark 7, 1986, 2-door, with 80,000 mi, I can't wait to bring it to your and help me restore this vehicle that I bought from a dear friend at fort Lee Virginia, which is now called Fort Adam , I will pass the word to my staff members who I had to pleasure of working with them over 15 years throughout the base. In my book your number one, that's why I will wear your model shirt and be proud to say the more family is number one

reviews.author: Robert Smith
reviews.text: Very unprofessional and had my car for over two months. And kept coming back with thing after thing wrong and told me to buy parts from Chevrolet so I did and then they plugged them in so I couldn’t return them and then ended up not using the parts. I would never recommend this place to anyone. Also they own a towing company and they couldn’t fix a part so with out my knowledge towed it to a specialist and charged for the tow.

reviews.author: Brooke Fournia
reviews.text: My boyfriend’s truck sat in this shop for almost a year and still had to be TOWED out of the lot because they were unable to find the TIME to fix it. Even after he paid $2,600 (mostly in cash to avoid the owner’s wife finding out?). PLEASE DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND AVOID THIS BUSINESS AT ALL COSTS! Especially if you have a valuable antique vehicle!

reviews.author: Michael Y. B. Rainmaker
reviews.text: Excellent service, quality work, worth the wait... I will bring all my vehicles to Moores now! my 2017 RAM drives sooo smooth now after a quality alignment, and High Speed wheel balancing!!! Highly Recommended!!!!

reviews.author: Rakim Johnson
reviews.text: I took my car to this shop On March 17th 2021 to get the ABS fixed And was told it would take 4-5 days for the part to arrive i called Again yesterday March 29th and was told that something happened at the dealership and that my part would be here in another 4-5 days Well i arrived to the dealership today and was told by another person that the part was indeed never ordered but they would be ordering it today. The unprofessionalism that this establishment embodies is pure comedy. The people who answer the phone never seem to communicate any information to one another and cannot remember information they give to the customers. I wouldnt Spend my money here if you need your car soon.

reviews.author: Annette Ahrend
reviews.text: My daughter took her car to Moores to get it worked on. He fixed it with no problem. He was very efficient at getting it fixed. He is an excellent mechanic.

reviews.author: Eddie val
reviews.text: I would advise you, if you have a year to wait on painting your vehicle, do not to take it there, they are backed up. And if you have money to spend, they quoted me 30k for a paint job, my vehicle is worth 25k as is. I'll let yall figure that out.

reviews.author: Hambone
reviews.text: Good experience with Ed,Tanner, & Ashley. They did good work to repair my 92 F150. Communication and customer service was okay. Always room for improvement. Overall good repair shop. Will go back for future services.

reviews.author: Melanie Dinsmore
reviews.text: Moore's Auto and Towing will always have my business. I know I call Eddie or Ashley at anytime day or night. If I need a tow I know that they will be there. I can not count how many times I have needed a part put on my vehicle and I have called and they have been able to do it without having to wait days. This is one shop that definitely goes ABOVE and BEYOND!!

reviews.author: Tony Kay
reviews.text: Great customer service as well as fast repairs.. very patient staff. They dealt with me and my mis haps.. lol.. and stayed professional the entire time.. Eddie is my guy got me back and running quickly and like that I’m back in the woods and I don’t think he broke a sweat.. thanks a lot moores.. I will go back without a doubt and they will be my first option.. this is the REAL Tony Kay.. thanks guys

reviews.author: Joe Mabe (Mabe's Home Improvement)
reviews.text: Great staff of people. Honest. Owner is a great guy. He helped me out with my vehicle. Best prices on repair work and they offer financing.

reviews.author: Kristin Dibler
reviews.text: Moore's is great! Ashley is prompt and thorough and kept me updated on progress and any unexpected findings. I definitely recommed!

reviews.author: Paul Gillum
reviews.text: The people at Moore's are extremely nice and helpful people they tell you when your getting into before they do it... But their pricing is on the pricey side so I took my car home to fix it myself and it turns out they charged me for a incorrect diagnosis unfortunately.

reviews.author: Jenita Johnson
reviews.text: They were fast and courteous! I even witnessed how they dealt with a difficult customer, and they were fair, honest and seemed to go above and beyond. Will be taking my vehicle back for sure.

reviews.author: Kevin Hargrow
reviews.text: I've used them before to do some major repairs for me and they did great work. I came back because I knew that I could trust them with my vehicle.

reviews.author: Barbara Flowers
reviews.text: Moores did great work on my brother,car so they came highly recommended to me.I for sure will recommended this business to anyone

reviews.author: Kevin Mason
reviews.text: Called in for a state inspection and Crystal was able to take me immediately.service was excellent and they were very professional.

reviews.author: Steve Bazzacco
reviews.text: This place is great. Their work is great and customer service is awsome as well. Wont go anywhere else.
